import subprocess
import sys

expected = {
    ("Ship parser", "--done"): "[done] Ship parser\n",
    ("Ship parser",): "[todo] Ship parser\n",
}

for args, wanted in expected.items():
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "src/cli.py", *args],
        check=True,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    assert result.stdout == wanted, (args, result.stdout, wanted)
    print(f"PASS: {' '.join(args)} -> {result.stdout.strip()}")
EOF
python /tmp/reproduce_status_label.py || true

if old not in text:
    raise SystemExit('expected source text not found')
path.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1))
PY
